variants.headline: Looking back: party leader blunders in election debate
variants.sub: An election debate has included a blunder by a party leader.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: A party leader had blundered in an election debate.

A debate error is not an economic programme or an electoral result. Business readers should avoid pricing an imagined policy reversal into a speaking mistake. A sound assessment distinguishes communication, political judgment and actual decisions, rather than treating a blunder as a complete forecast of what a party would do.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The performance of {target} deserves examination without assuming an electoral effect. This paper records the blunder and leaves the words involved and the public's response outside its factual account where they are unspecified.
